versions.content: For inter-partition routing paths, the call to the following func- tions shall only execute code that is assigned to the same ECUC partition: • PduR_<SrcLo>RxIndication , • PduR_<DstLo>TriggerTransmit , • PduR_<DstLo>TxConfirmation . PduR shall not call the <DstLo>_Transmit in the call context of PduR_<SrcLo> RxIndication . PduR shall call <DstLo>_Transmit in the ECUC partition context of the <DstLo> module (in fact of the ECUC partition context defined via the EcucPdu DefaultPartitionRef or the EcucPduDedicatedPartitionRef of the PduR- DestPduRef ).
